wins.label: Strong Data Center Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Data Center segment revenue increased 14% year-over-year to $3.2 billion.

wins.label: EPYC and Ryzen Sales Outperformance
wins.evidence: Revenue exceeded the midpoint of guidance as higher EPYC and Ryzen processor sales more than offset headwinds from export controls.

wins.label: MI350 Series Adoption
wins.evidence: We made solid progress with MI300 and MI325 in the quarter, closing new wins and expanding adoption with Tier 1 customers.

wins.label: Strong Free Cash Flow
wins.evidence: We delivered over $1 billion in free cash flow.

wins.label: AI Software Advancements
wins.evidence: ROCm 7 delivers more than 3x higher inferencing and training performance compared to our prior generation.

risks.label: Inventory Write-Down

risks.label: Uncertainty in License Approvals for MI308

risks.label: Seasonal Decline in Gaming Segment
